run_sync_skills: run sync_skills to copy bundled skills into ~/.hermes/skills/ using manifest-based tracking
reset_bundled_skill: reset a bundled skill's manifest tracking so future syncs work normally after user modifications
summarize_sync_skills: summarize the sync_skills function that manages manifest-based seeding and updating of bundled skills
review_reset_bundled_skill: review the reset_bundled_skill function that clears manifest entries and optionally restores user copies
test_sync_skills: test the sync_skills function with quiet mode to verify manifest-based skill synchronization logic
